inj.note: Norman-Lott was removed from the PUP list prior to the expiration of his 21-day practice window. He was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice, and his participation over the next two days will determine whether he'll make his 2026 regular-season debut against the Cardinals on Sunday. Norman-Lott is in the final stages of his recovery from a torn ACL that he sustained in reporters 2025.
